You will hear Eva telling Dad what her friends did yesterday afternoon.
Dad: Did Leo go shopping?
Eva: No. Leo drew pictures at home.
Dad: What did Ruby do?
Eva: Ruby went to the library.
Dad: And Sam?
Eva: Sam played football in the park.
Dad: Did Mia watch a film?
Eva: Yes, Mia watched a film with her cousin.
Dad: What about Ben?
Eva: Ben baked biscuits with his mum.
